supplies_quest.title: Expedition Supplies
supplies_quest.text: An expedition requires significant resources. Provide the required resources to cover the costs.

dispatch_quest.title: Select Who Departs
dispatch_quest.text: Select a hearthling to send on an expedition. WARNING: They will not return.

departure_dialog.title: Expedition Underway
departure_dialog.message: Your hearthling begins to depart on their expedition. We wish them the best of luck!
